meta.title: PROJET PERMIS BÉNIN — Premium driving school in Benin
meta.description: Learn to drive with PROJET PERMIS BÉNIN. A1 to D training, online courses, professional support. The road to your freedom starts here.

hero.title: Take the wheel of your freedom.
hero.subtitle: Learn to drive with PROJET PERMIS BÉNIN. Discover our training programs and prepare your future on the road.

about.label: About
about.title: A driving school committed to your success
about.subtitle: PROJET PERMIS BÉNIN supports driving licence candidates across Benin, with seriousness, modernity and proximity.
about.missionText: Make learning to drive accessible, professional and adapted to Benin's realities, to train responsible and confident drivers.
about.visionText: Become a national reference in driver training, combining modern pedagogy, human support and useful technologies.
about.engagementText: Rigorous supervision, maintained vehicles, flexible hours and personalised follow-up of each candidate until the exam.
about.accompanimentText: From registration to the exam, we guide you at every step: theory, practice, online revisions and personalised advice.

whyus.label: Why choose us
whyus.title: Training designed for your success
whyus.subtitle: Concrete benefits to learn to drive with peace of mind.
whyus.item1Text: Experienced and pedagogical instructors, listening to you at every session.
whyus.item2Text: Learn on maintained vehicles adapted to each licence category.
whyus.item3Text: Time slots adapted to your schedule, day or evening.
whyus.item4Text: Revise the highway code and key concepts anywhere, at your own pace.
whyus.item5Text: Training in French and Fongbe to serve every learner.
whyus.item6Text: Present in several cities across Benin to stay close to you.

formations.label: Our training
formations.title: A category for every vehicle
formations.subtitle: Choose the training adapted to the vehicle you want to drive.
formations.A1Desc: Training for light motorcycles. Master balance, safety and the highway code.
formations.A2Desc: For mid-size motorcycles. Learn urban and road driving safely.
formations.A3Desc: Riding heavy motorcycles. Advanced riding and safety techniques.
formations.BDesc: The car licence, the most popular. Urban driving, parking, manoeuvres and the highway code.
formations.CDesc: Heavy goods vehicle training. Master utility vehicles and freight transport.
formations.C1Desc: For larger capacity trucks. Professional driving and reinforced safety.
formations.DDesc: Driving coaches and passenger transport. Demanding training and increased responsibility.

pricing.label: Our pricing
pricing.title: Clear, staggered pricing
pricing.subtitle: Choose your training language. Payment is made in instalments to make it easier for you.
pricing.note: The exact conditions and any associated fees per category must be confirmed with the company. The information above corresponds to the communicated prices.

online.label: Online courses
online.title: Revise wherever you are
online.subtitle: PROJET PERMIS BÉNIN offers online courses to complement your in-person training.
online.description: Access revision materials for the highway code and essential concepts, at your own pace, from your phone or computer.
online.feature1Text: Revise signs, rules and practical cases.
online.feature2Text: Compatible with your Android or iPhone.
online.feature3Text: Flexible progression based on your availability.
online.note: The exact terms of access to online courses are specified when you register.

howto.label: How to register
howto.title: Your registration in 4 steps
howto.subtitle: A simple, supported journey from start to finish.
howto.step1Text: Identify the licence for the vehicle you want to drive.
howto.step2Text: Provide your contact details and desired training language.
howto.step3Text: Submit your request directly to our team.
howto.step4Text: We contact you to finalise your registration and schedule your courses.

zones.label: Coverage areas
zones.title: Present across Benin
zones.subtitle: Find PROJET PERMIS BÉNIN in several cities across the country.

contact.subtitle: A question? Call us or message us on WhatsApp.
contact.locationNote: Precise addresses are provided when you register.
